_note: Prices in US$. Income is about $20-30 per game day (one real hour) from Junie's board and the cooler, plus the Trust's pay for each survey; the full catalogue should take most of Act 1 to own. 'unlock' = the story step that must be finished before Junie stocks it. Lures other than the start lures are lost when the line breaks.

notes.sinker_half_oz: Plain weight on the bottom. Catfish and bullheads
notes.bait_worm_bobber: A worm under a float. Every panfish in the pond
notes.texas_worm_7in: Weedless soft plastic. Crawl it for bass
notes.jig_quarter_oz: Hop it along the bottom. Skips under cover
notes.popper_2in: Topwater. Twitch it and wait at dawn and dusk
notes.crankbait_square_2in: Dives about a metre. Bounce it off wood
notes.ultralight: Light line, soft tip: small fish fight harder, light baits cast further
notes.spinning_fluoro: Fluoro sinks and stretches less: firmer hooksets at range
notes.spinning_braid: 20 lb braid, no stretch: gar, bowfin and snags
notes.baitcaster_mh: Heavy cover and big fish. Thumb the spool or it bird's-nests

market._note: US$ per kg paid at the bait shop for kept fish (simplified, frozen regs: every species sells).
